purpose: Cross-check the B0380 Neostethus villadolidi discovery candidate against an additional accessible peer-reviewed range summary, without converting an archipelago-level statement into a northern Luzon occurrence.

source.citation: Parenti, L. R., & Louie, K. D. (1998). Neostethus djajaorum, new species, from Sulawesi, Indonesia, the first phallostethid fish (Teleostei: Atherinomorpha) known from east of Wallace's Line. The Raffles Bulletin of Zoology, 46(1), 139–150.
source.fullText: Publisher-hosted PDF opened and reviewed; local ignored snapshot SHA-256 B5D94509ECBB842D2E1A08BECFF83F95830070C1793EBF8549B1E38B3B71E592.
source.reuse: The PDF carries a National University of Singapore copyright notice. No item-specific open license or permission for app reuse was verified; research notes only.

finding.reportedRange: The paper's genus-level composition-and-distribution summary describes Neostethus villadolidi as occurring 'throughout Philippines'.
finding.sourceScope: The paper primarily describes N. djajaorum from Sulawesi. The broad N. villadolidi range phrase is a taxonomic summary, not a specimen-by-locality record in this article.
finding.localityEvidence: The reviewed pages name no N. villadolidi site in northern Luzon, Cagayan River, or basin B0380. The previously reviewed type locality is Cagayan de Misamis, Mindanao; it remains a separate geographic name.
finding.basinInterpretation: The phrase broadens historical archipelago-level range context but cannot confirm or refute the B0380 association, identify a waterbody, or establish current presence.

interpretation: A nationwide range summary is not a Cagayan River occurrence or a citation-to-basin crosswalk.
The candidate's specific northern Luzon basin association remains unvalidated; a lack of a named locality in this source is not evidence of absence.
Do not infer habitat salinity, catchability, diet, legal status, safety, or exact geometry from this range statement.
